description: This file contains utility functions for managing object permission updates, including attaching permissions to dictionaries, handling updates, and creating permission records in a database, specifically for a system using Prisma ORM.

methods.name: attach_object_permission_to_dict
methods.description: Attaches object permission details to a dictionary if 'object_permission_id' is present, querying the database for the permission record.

methods.name: handle_update_object_permission_common
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating or creating object permission records in the database, merging new permissions with existing ones.

methods.name: _set_object_permission
methods.description: Creates a new object permission record in the database and updates the input data with the new permission ID.
